content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Rishikesh
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rishikesh is a government medical institute in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand (PIN 249203). Its Recruitment Cell issued this notice dated 9 October 2026 for a Group-A administrative post on deputation basis.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Only officers who meet the eligibility conditions may apply. The application must be in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-A) and must be forwarded through proper channel. The steps in the notice are: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma, Annexure-A. Attach attested copies of all relevant certificates and the enclosures listed below. Submit it to your present employer, which forwards it through proper channel after checking that your particulars are verified and that you meet the eligibility conditions. Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of Senior Administrative Officer on deputation basis". Send it by Speed Post/Registered Post ONLY to: Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, Pin-249203. Make sure it reaches the Recruitment Cell by 23 November 2026 or within 30 days from the date of publication in Employment News.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: AIIMS Rishikesh has advertised 1 Group-A post on deputation basis. The notice says the number of posts is tentative and liable to change based on the Institute's requirements. Officers under the Central / State / U.T. Governments / Universities / Statutory / Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations: i. Holding analogous posts on regular basis, Or ii. With 5 years regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 5400/- in the relevant field. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The notice states that the qualification and eligibility prescribed are a minimum requirement and do not automatically make a candidate eligible for selection. The maximum age limit for applying on deputation is 56 years as on the last date of receipt of application. Experience and age will be calculated as on 23 November 2026, the last date to receive application forms. Pay: Level 11 (Rs. 67700-208700). The period of deputation shall be initially for 2 years as per DoPT norms / Govt. of India rules. The deputation will be governed by the standard terms and conditions of deputation under the Department of Personnel & Training's O.M.No.6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended from time to time. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application forwarded through proper channel must carry attested copies of all relevant certificates, along with: Duly attested photocopies of Confidential Reports of the applicant (last five years) Vigilance Clearance Certificate duly signed by an authorized officer, clearly indicating that no disciplinary or criminal proceedings are either pending or contemplated against the officer concerned Latest Salary Slip mentioning designation and grade pay & Level Statement showing the minor/major penalties imposed, if any A certificate about the integrity of the officer recommended for deputation An application without vigilance clearance and attested copies of CR Dossiers will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Institute will shortlist candidates based on their bio-data, and shortlisted candidates may be called for an interview. At the time of the interview, candidates have to produce all relevant original documents as proof of the details given in their application. An application received without the proper channel will not be considered for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 for Senior Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: There is 01 Group-A post of Senior Administrative Officer under Advt. No. 2026/38. The number is tentative and liable to change based on the Institute's requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The application with its essential documents must reach the Recruitment Cell by 23 November 2026 or within 30 days from the date of publication in Employment News.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Administrative Officer post on deputation?
faq.answer: Officers under the Central / State / U.T. Governments, Universities, Statutory or Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations can apply if they hold analogous posts on a regular basis, or have 5 years' regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 5400/- in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 56 years as on the last date of receipt of application. Age and experience are calculated as on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Level 11 (Rs. 67700-208700).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-A) through proper channel, with the enclosures, by Speed Post/Registered Post only to: Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, Pin-249203.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the post of Senior Administrative Officer on deputation basis" on the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Rishikesh Senior Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The Institute will shortlist candidates based on their bio-data, and shortlisted candidates may be called for an interview, where they have to produce their original documents.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation at AIIMS Rishikesh?
faq.answer: The deputation will initially be for 2 years as per DoPT norms / Govt. of India rules. It is governed by DoPT's O.M.No.6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q10. Will an application without vigilance clearance be accepted?
faq.answer: No. An application without vigilance clearance and attested copies of CR Dossiers will not be considered, and an application received without the proper channel will not be considered for the interview.
